build_lstm_rnn: build a Haiku LSTM RNN core with a specified hidden size for sequence modeling
build_gru_rnn: build a Haiku GRU recurrent core with configurable hidden size and weight initializers
build_vanilla_rnn: build a basic fully-connected VanillaRNN core with ReLU activation and optional double bias
build_deep_rnn: build a DeepRNN that stacks multiple RNN cores and callables as a single core
run_dynamic_unroll: run dynamic unroll of an RNN core over an input sequence using jax.lax.scan
